references.text: Concerns impurity due to seminal emission and the requirements for cleansing, which is the specific situation described in Deuteronomy 23:11
Describes rules about impurity and the requirement to stay away from holy things until one is clean again
The command to send unclean persons out of the camp to preserve the holiness of the camp, the same principle as in this text
Concerns ritual impurity and the necessity of cleansing before one can return to the community
General laws about impurity related to bodily discharges, which form the background for the provisions in Deuteronomy
